title: Love Letters Without Writing
synopsis: The Jingpo people in Yunnan express their love using special love letters. These love letters do not have any letters in them, but they instead use plants to express feelings.

fullText.simplified:
没有文字的“情书”

    云南景颇族的男女青年谈恋爱时，常以一些植物叶子作“情书”。这种“情书”虽然没有文字，含义却很明白。
    如果男子爱上姑娘，就会用树叶包上树根、大蒜、火柴、辣椒，送给那个姑娘。树根代表“想念”，大蒜表示要姑娘考虑两人的事，辣椒代表炽热的爱，火柴代表态度的坚决，叶子代表有好多话要说。
    这种树叶情书一般是用大芭蕉叶作信封，交给自己的好朋友送去。对方也会很快“回信”。如果里面是一大堆乱七八糟的树叶，那就代表对方不愿和你谈恋爱。
    这种情书还有更简化版的。比如送“石根哈”叶子表示“我真心向你求爱，请不要拒绝我”；送“木克”叶子表示“咱俩发誓永远相爱，永不变心”；如果收到对方的“莫那”叶子，就意味着被对方拒绝了，因为“莫那”叶子表示“我不能和你在一起，不然别人会笑话我”。
fullText.traditional:
沒有文字的“情書”

    雲南景頗族的男女青年談戀愛時，常以一些植物葉子作“情書”。這種“情書”雖然沒有文字，含義卻很明白。
    如果男子愛上姑娘，就會用樹葉包上樹根、大蒜、火柴、辣椒，送給那個姑娘。樹根代表“想念”，大蒜表示要姑娘考慮兩人的事，辣椒代表熾熱的愛，火柴代表態度的堅決，葉子代表有好多話要說。
    這種樹葉情書一般是用大芭蕉葉作信封，交給自己的好朋友送去。對方也會很快“回信”。如果裡面是一大堆亂七八糟的樹葉，那就代表對方不願和你談戀愛。
    這種情書還有更簡化版的。比如送“石根哈”葉子表示“我真心向你求愛，請不要拒絕我”；送“木克”葉子表示“咱倆發誓永遠相愛，永不變心”；如果收到對方的“莫那”葉子，就意味著被對方拒絕了，因為“莫那”葉子表示“我不能和你在一起，不然別人會笑話我”。

raw.synopsis: The Jingpo people in Yunnan express their love using special love letters. These love letters do not have any letters in them, but they instead use plants to express feelings.
sentence_translations: When young men and women of the Jingpo people in Yunnan date, they often write “love letters” using leaves from plants.
Even though this type of “love letter” doesn't have words, the meaning is very clear.
If a man falls in love with a girl, he uses tree leaves to wrap tree roots, garlic, matches and chili pepper and send to the girl.
A tree root represents “longing”, garlic represents that you want the girl to consider the two of you together, ..
.. chili pepper represents passionate love, matches represent a firm attitude, and leaves mean that you have a lot of things you want to say.
This type of leaf love letter is often made using large banana leaves as envelopes, and are handed to a friend to deliver.
The counterpart will also respond very quickly.
If the contents are a big messy pile of tree leaves, that means the counterpart does not agree to date you.
These love letters also have an even more simplified version.
For example, sending a “Shigenha” leaf means “I sincerely request your love, please do not reject me.”
Sending a “Muke” leaf means “The two of us pledge eternal love, and to never cease to be faithful.”
If you receive a “Mona” leaf from the counterpart, it means that they reject you.
Because a “Mona” leaf means “I can not be together with you, or people will make fun of me.”
